title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - AccumulatedBalance
description: Represents and tracks the aggregated amount remained or owed in certain account which is owned by certain customer for a set of buckets. (TM Forum TMF654 Prepay Balance Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition AccumulatedBalance; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:AccumulatedBalance:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AccumulatedBalance'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:AccumulatedBalance:<tmfId>. Unique Identifier within the server for the recharge operation request

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/href'. A resource URI pointing to the resource in the OB that stores the detailed information.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/description'. Text describing the contents of the aggregated balance

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/name'. Friendly name to identify the aggregated balance

bucket.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/bucket'. A reference to the buckets involved in the aggregation. In TMF this is an array of BucketRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Bucket entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Bucket:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

logicalResource.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/logicalResource'. A reference to the logical resource that can be used to identify the bucket balance for example where product ids are not unique.

partyAccount.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/partyAccount'. A reference to the account that owns the buckets aggregated. In TMF this is a PartyAccountRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced PartyAccount entity (urn:ngsi-ld:PartyAccount:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

product.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF654_PrepayBalanceManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF654-PrepayBalance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/AccumulatedBalance/properties/product'. A reference to the product whose consumption is managed by the bucket . This is an array to allow scenarios where a buckets are shared between different products. In TMF this is an array of ProductRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Product entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Product:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

Used to provide information about any other entity with relation to the balance, for instance to define customer hierarchy for the balance (e.g.: customerId, userId, )
